evidence.excerpt: We present a unified benchmark that evaluates representative machine learning, reinforcement learning, LLM-based, and agent-based trading methods in cryptocurrency markets through three progressively more realistic stages: historical backtesting, prospective exchange-based paper trading, and real-money live trading.
